_comment: Each mandatory clause of the project's own test rules, restated as
something a grep can find. This file is the machine-readable half of
rule changes, this file changes in the same commit, or neither does
(EPIC-009's Principle 8). A clause with zero hits is a written promise

clauses.requirement: Sanity must construct the real View + Presenter — directly, or through the real router for every navigable route
Sanity must boot the real app via create_app()

Sanity must fail on any problem-level diagnostic emitted during boot/construct/shutdown, on every channel the app owns (Python logging, Qt message handler, warnings) — the retired quick_widget.errors() clause's successor
Sanity must assert the app shuts down within a budget, not just call stop() in teardown

Every assertion scans a real source of truth (registered use cases, navigable routes, screen packages on disk) rather than naming features by hand — the mechanism that makes 'adding a feature adds zero new sanity tests' true
The OUT-of-process layer must launch the real entry point as a real subprocess, not import it — the only tier that can prove the process actually exits
Integration must drive real input and wait on a terminal signal/state
